provenance.warning: WHAT THIS DOES NOT PROVE. This is a live capture of the SHIPPING path — banker reading a CUSTOMER-owned account (casey) — and it supersedes the 2026-09-08 capture, which was taken as banker against a BANKER-OWNED account, a configuration the product no longer runs after docs/design/banker-customer-read-ruling.md. Three limits remain. (1) It is still the HAPPY PATH: 200 with rows. The failed-read path is captured separately and deliberately is NOT here — see tests/fixtures/evidence-samples/failed-reads/. (2) It proves the shape was true at capture time against one deployment; it does not prove the shape is stable, and no test in this repo re-reads the live service. (3) The 2026-09-08 warning described an asymmetry — get_account 404 vs list_account_transactions 200-with-empty-array — where an empty array could satisfy EvidenceComplete while asserting something false. That specific defect is FIXED: a banker now reads a customer's account successfully, and per docs/design/empty-ledger-narrowing-ruling.md a non-privileged caller who cannot prove entitlement is refused 403 rather than handed an empty array. An empty array from this tool now means the ledger is empty and nothing else. That is a stronger position, not a safe one: a captured payload invites more trust than it has earned.
